description: This file provides transformation logic for converting messages between OpenAI format and Gemini format, specifically for use in Google Vertex AI's Gemini models. It handles parsing different content types (text, images, files, audio), converting message histories, and preparing request bodies for API calls. Additionally, it includes utility functions for key normalization and part existence checks.
